gpu_bench_sum_header: Renderer | Tiles | Result | Backend·MSAA | Load | Init | Scene | Compile | First draw | First frame | Ready total (excl. load) | fps | p50 | p95 | Max | Over 50ms | CPU p50 | CPU p95 | GPU p50 | GPU p95 | GPU done/s | GPU pending | Draws | Triangles | Heap MB | JS KB (sent/raw) | Note
gpu_bench_sum_footnote: Times are in ms. Rows are in run order (the renderer order shifts by one for each tile count). fps, p50 and p95 = frame interval. CPU = time inside render(). Compile = shaders and pipelines per material (WebGL includes the link check). First draw includes uploading every tile buffer. Ready total = init + scene + compile + first frame. GPU p50 and p95 = from submit until the frame start where the finished work is seen, so both APIs round up to whole frame intervals. Compare APIs by GPU done/s (below fps means the GPU fell behind). Notes: first_use = first time this page started that API (init includes one-time start-up), no_msaa = WebGPU compatibility mode turned MSAA off (do not compare directly with ×4 rows).

units_satisfaction_low: Low satisfaction makes this unit easier for others to win over.
units_parties_note: A party holds up to 6 units. Group parties into a legion, up to the commander's capacity. Roles come from stats and gear.
units_parties_empty_body: Pick units from the list to form a party. It shows here with its formation.
units_presets_note: Save who does which job under a name, then apply it again in one go.
units_presets_empty_body: After giving units jobs, you can save the current assignment as a preset.
units_managers_note: A human manager runs a base on their own, like a governor. What you can hand over shows here once it's set.
units_managers_empty_body: Once you have a base, you can put a human in charge of it.
units_auction_note: Units are traded only in auction houses by type. A listing with a buyout price can be bought at once. There is no one-to-one trading.
units_auction_empty_body: Once a unit trading building opens, human, creature, android, part and vehicle listings show here.
units_prisoners_note: You can list a prisoner for ransom (only the original owner can buy), win them over, or execute them.
units_prisoners_mine_empty: None of your units are captured.
cyborg_body_later: Your body's details appear after first-time setup (look and starting stats).
cyborg_stats_later: Primary and secondary stats show here once you have a level.
cyborg_skills_later: Skills from your gear and organs show here.
cyborg_gear_later: Weapon, off-hand, head, body and two accessory slots show here.
cyborg_organs_note: Organs change your primary stats and skills, and stay through rebirth.
cyborg_inventory_later: Items you carry show here. Your warehouse is on the Economy screen.
holdings_cooldown_note: Potion and food cooldowns run separately.
holdings_slot_no_choices: Nothing you carry fits this slot.
holdings_replace_body: Only one effect from this group can be active. Using {item} ends:
holdings_done_use_missed: Used {item}, but no effect took hold.
holdings_error_busy: The world is busy. Try again shortly.
holdings_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment.
holdings_error_internal_error: A server error stopped this. Nothing changed.
holdings_error_no_owner: You don't have units in the world yet.
holdings_error_unknown_holding: That item is gone. The list was refreshed.
holdings_error_unknown_item: That item doesn't exist or is turned off.
holdings_error_not_holdable: That's a bulk good (ledger stock), not a holdable item.
holdings_error_not_carried: No unit is carrying that item (it's in storage).
holdings_error_wrong_slot: That can't go in this slot.
holdings_error_broken: Durability is 0, so it can't be equipped. Repair it first.
holdings_error_battle_only: That effect only works in battle.
holdings_error_not_better: Your current effect is as strong or stronger, so nothing was used.
holdings_error_confirm_replace: This replaces an effect in the same group. Confirm to use it.
holdings_error_cooldown: On cooldown. You can use it again in {time}.
holdings_error_offline: Connection lost, so the result is unknown. The list was refreshed.
holdings_error_timeout: No reply came. The list was refreshed.
holdings_dev_note: Only dev and admin see this. The unit carries what it gets, and stats roll as on pickup.
holdings_no_cyborg_unit: Your cyborg isn't in the world yet, so gear can't change.
holdings_packed_note: Packed food keeps its freshness. Unpack it to get a single item that starts to spoil.
holdings_error_not_packed: This is not packed food, so it can't be unpacked.
cyborg_rebirth_changes_body: Your level goes back to 1 and experience to 0 (no experience boost). You can keep your stat spread, or pick a temperament and reroll it as at creation ({rerolls} rerolls, no manual allocation). Growth is always rerolled, even if you keep your spread. You can keep or re-split your 10 basic element points. Faith resets to 0.
cyborg_rebirth_keeps_body: Artificial organs stay installed. Skill slots and max skill grade gained from earlier rebirths stay too.
cyborg_rebirth_gains_body: +1 skill slot, +1 max skill grade and a free change of look. Using a path religious item also gives light or dark element points, or that religion's special skill.
cyborg_rebirth_currency_value: {amount} · currency of the city with the rebirth facility
cyborg_rebirth_items_value: Optional: use one to open the light or dark branch, or to get that religion's special skill (not needed for a basic rebirth)
cyborg_rebirth_place: Rebirth takes place at a rebirth facility (temple). The body swap at your home port is a cutscene.
cyborg_rebirth_k: A rebirth facility shows your growth rate (K).
cyborg_ranking_later: Rankings for the paths you take part in show here.
cyborg_ranking_note: Each path is ranked separately. Timed buffs don't count.
ranking_house_note: The house board adds up each member's score on this path. NPC city houses also add up each member's own score on this path (for now, battles they won). Previous ranks aren't kept yet.
ranking_unit_measures: One unit's {measure} — value at the last tally
ranking_me_no_unit: None of your units is on this board.
ranking_unit_note: The unit board ranks each unit by the value counted at the last tally (it doesn't build up or decay). Assets count only that unit's own wallet — the owner's storage and businesses count on the player board. Your row is your highest-ranked unit.
ranking_measure_battle_wins: Battle wins incl. wave defence (vs. enemy strength)
ranking_measure_combat_power: Combined combat power of your units (base values without buffs, log)
ranking_measure_assets: Assets: wallets, goods at market price, business shares (log)
ranking_faction_measures: Cities, development, humans and treasury (size at tally)
ranking_me_no_house: Your house isn't on this board.
ranking_me_none: No score on this board yet.
ranking_me_no_faction: Your faction isn't on this board.
ranking_renown_note: Faction renown comes from repelling gardener waves. It isn't added to the score.
ranking_empty: Nobody has scored on this board yet.
ranking_unknown: No such path. Pick another board.
ranking_pending: Waiting for the first tally. The server counts within minutes of starting.
ranking_rules_note: Scores shrink {decay}% each tally, so stay active to keep them. Timed buffs don't count.
ranking_preview_notice: These rankings are filled with test data.
faction_identity_unset: You have no house yet. Choose a name, tag, colour and emblem, the same way NPC nations have them, and your house is founded.
faction_identity_note: You belong to one nation: every member is a citizen of the nation of the house's home city. When the house gains a city, it chooses to stay a vassal or go independent.
faction_identity_notice_removed: A moderator removed your uploaded emblem. Your generated emblem is shown now.
faction_identity_load_failed: Could not load your faction identity.
faction_identity_unavailable: Faction identity is not available on this server.
fid_lead: Choose your faction's name, tag, colour and emblem, the same steps NPC nations go through. All four are required.
fid_preview_title: How it looks in the game
fid_name_hint: Unique on this server. 2–8 Hangul characters, or 3–16 letters and digits. No spaces or symbols, and no real country or city names.
fid_namegen_note: Suggestions are made-up names. You can edit one after picking it.
fid_short_hint: A short tag shown on the map and in lists. {min}–{max} letters or digits, unique on this server.
fid_color_hint: Twenty colours that stay readable on both light and dark maps.
fid_upload_hint: Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP image and crop it to a square; it is shrunk to {size} × {size}. Only the cropped part is uploaded. The original file never leaves your device.
fid_upload_rules: Do not upload offensive images, real flags or trademarks, or other people's work. Moderators can remove an emblem.
fid_upload_ready: Cropped image selected. It is uploaded when you save below.
fid_upload_none: No image chosen yet. Without one, the generated emblem is used.
fid_upload_unreadable: Could not read that image. Check that it is a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
fid_upload_off: Image uploads are turned off in this world right now. The generated emblem is used.
fid_upload_blocked: This account cannot upload images. The generated emblem is used.
fid_crop_view: Crop area. Drag or use the arrow keys to move, and the + and − keys to zoom.
fid_crop_hint: Drag to move, then zoom. The small previews show it at 24, 48 and 128 px.
fid_crop_too_large: Could not get the image under {kb} KB. Try a simpler image.
fid_rename_wait: You can change the name and tag again from {date}. Colour and emblem can be changed now.
fid_name_invalid_chars: Use only Hangul, letters and digits. Spaces and symbols are not allowed.
fid_name_too_short: Too short. Use at least 2 Hangul characters or 3 letters and digits.
fid_name_too_long: Too long. Use at most 8 Hangul characters or 16 letters and digits.
fid_name_reserved: That name could be mistaken for staff and cannot be used.
fid_name_real_place: Real country and city names cannot be used.
fid_name_taken: That faction name is taken. Upper and lower case count as the same name.
fid_short_invalid: Use only Hangul characters, letters or digits.
fid_short_reserved: That tag could be mistaken for staff and cannot be used.
fid_error_rate_limited: Too many saves. Try again in a little while.
fid_error_emblem: The image was not accepted. Crop it again and retry.
fid_error_rename_wait: The name and tag cannot be changed yet.
fid_error_failed: Could not save. Try again in a little while.
cyborg_core_note_max: Tap a bar (or hover with a mouse) to see where the total comes from. At max level your growth rate (K) and starting values are shown. Rebirth rerolls K.
cyborg_core_note: Tap a bar (or hover with a mouse) to see where the total comes from. Growth rate (K) shows at max level, at a rebirth facility and at a biotech facility.
formula_curve_note: curve(score, cap, half) = cap × score ÷ (score + half)
cyborg_attack_formula: Stat attack + weapon attack × min(1, {stat} ÷ required)
cyborg_stamina_real_formula: Actual regen = row value × min(2, STA score ÷ appropriate STA)
cyborg_buff_legend: Pill = share from active effects (buffs and debuffs). In battle = base + share
cyborg_attack_bare_hit_formula: Bare-hand hit = always 100% (misses come only from the target's evade)
cyborg_move_formula: Walking speed = base + AGI × weight (capped) — formula walk_speed
cyborg_move_formula_old: Vehicle speed (walking) + Σ(primary stat × weight) + gear
cyborg_move_vehicle: Vehicles and boats use their own speed (the lower of vehicle and road top speed)
cyborg_move_no_stats: No primary stat or gear share — move speed is not a secondary stat; vehicle and road decide it
cyborg_move_result: = {value} · one local map ({cells} cells) in about {minutes} min
cyborg_gather_formula: Effective stat = main + sub + condition + facility level bonus
cyborg_gather_best_line: Best job — the primary production with the most expected money per hour (tier odds × price × count ÷ time)
cyborg_elements_note: Element values (0–10 per cell) come from creation (split 10 points over up to two of water, fire, wind and earth), rebirth (keep or re-split; a religious rebirth picks light or dark), organs, gear and faith. Each cell stops at 10.
cyborg_footer_time: Computed by the server from saved values · as of {time}
dev_tool_second_map_desc: Open any local map without units and change the time, place, height exaggeration and grid (view only, game state never changes).
second_map_lab_view_label: Local map lab view. Drag with one finger to move, use two fingers to zoom and rotate. Tap to see that cell's values.
second_map_lab_error_none: This planet has no place like that.
second_map_lab_error_bad_key: That isn't a local map key on this planet (different face level or outside the face).
second_map_lab_error_not_ready: The server is still preparing terrain. Try again shortly.
second_map_lab_error_forbidden: You don't have permission to use this screen.
second_map_lab_build_ask: This builds the planet (F{level}) on this device for the first time. It takes about 15 s on a desktop and uses a lot of worker memory. Phone time and memory are unknown.
second_map_lab_sky_off_hint: With day and night off, the map uses the same fixed daylight.
second_map_lab_exaggeration_hint: Game heights are 1/12 of real heights; ×12 is the real ratio. Only the view changes, the terrain data stays the same. The game's 2nd map view draws ×4.
second_map_lab_exaggeration_cap: This map's height range only allows up to ×{max}.
second_map_lab_prop_span: Tree and rock models when the view is under {m} m
second_map_lab_cell_hint: Tap the map to see that cell's values.
second_map_lab_planet_cell: This map's planet cell F{level} (one local map is one planet cell)
economy_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. Order and production buttons won't send commands.
economy_preview_hint: Turn on sample data in Home → Edit to try a sample exchange.
economy_not_ready_market: The exchange isn't open yet. Once it opens, you can buy and sell goods in every city.
economy_not_ready_production: You don't own any production facilities yet. Once you do, schedule production here.
economy_not_ready_exchange: The exchange opens when the city economy is running. It then collects orders and clears them together at set times.
economy_not_ready_orders: Your orders will appear here once the exchange opens.
economy_capacity_unit_note: Capacity counts trade lots for now (1 kg lots for ore, single items otherwise). The final unit is weight (kg), so it switches to kg once item weights are set.
economy_recipe_select: Grown at the building level's tier · {stats}
economy_worker_formula: Speed = max(1, ⌊{primary} ÷ {divisor}⌋) · per harvest {base} + ⌊{secondary} × {rate}⌋, up to {cap}
economy_worker_harvest: Per harvest T0 {t0} · T1 {t1} · T2 {t2} · T3 {t3}
economy_lot_note: Prices and quantities are per lot ({size}).
economy_no_owner: You don't own anything in this world yet. Put units to work and their output will pile up here.
economy_wage_formula: Wage = efficiency × rate (city base rate + your adjustment)
labor_rules: Wage: deposit = wage × {days} days, warning when less than {warn} days are left, automatic firing when it runs out, paused when one wage is not covered. Lease: hourly rent; unpaid rent, the end of the term or ending it by either side starts a grace period of {grace} to collect leftover goods.
labor_not_ready: The world is starting up, so contracts are not available yet.
labor_end_deposit_used_up: The deposit ran out, so the worker was fired.
labor_end_rent_unpaid: Ended because the rent was not paid.
labor_end_unit_gone: Ended because the unit is gone.
labor_end_building_gone: Ended because the facility is gone.
labor_field_term: Term (hours, leave empty for no term)
labor_units_other_map: Free units on other second maps ({count}) can't work at this facility and are left out.
labor_rent_title: Rent for my facilities (hourly, 0 = not for lease)
labor_error_busy: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
labor_error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
labor_error_forbidden: That facility, unit or contract is not yours.
labor_error_unit_busy: That unit already has a contract.
labor_error_invalid_terms: Those terms are outside the rules.
labor_error_not_for_lease: That facility is not for lease.
labor_error_not_open: That contract has ended or is in its grace period.
labor_error_offline: Connection lost. Check the list again.
labor_error_timeout: No answer. Check the list again.
labor_error_job_not_open: That job is gone or already closed.
labor_error_employer_insufficient_funds: The facility owner cannot cover the deposit.
labor_error_not_workplace: That facility is not a workplace (not a gathering facility, or still being built).
labor_error_facility_full: All worker slots at that facility are taken.
labor_error_not_assigned: That unit is not assigned to a job.
labor_error_wrong_map: That unit is not on the same second map as the facility. Only units on that map can work there.
labor_grace_note: During the grace period the tenant can take out their share from the facility storage. When it ends, the goods left there pass to the facility owner.
labor_leftovers_moved: The grace period ended and the goods left in the facility storage passed to the facility owner.
labor_terminate_grace_hint: A lease ends after a {grace} grace period.
labor_jobs_hint: Take a job at someone else's facility with your unit to start a wage contract. The facility owner pays the deposit and the wage goes to that human's own purse.
labor_jobs_rate_note: Until city labor markets exist, the base rate applies and every unit counts as a standard unit.
labor_job_other_map: Not on the chosen unit's second map
labor_post_hint: One posting per facility; posting again replaces it. The deposit leaves your wallet when someone takes the job.
labor_post_preview: Standard unit wage {wage} / {cycle} · deposit {deposit} per hire
economy_recipe_time_from: From {time} with one standard worker (all T0)
economy_market_auction_note: Finished goods like equipment trade in auction listings (coming soon). Gems of the same type, tier and grade are interchangeable, so they trade on the order book.
economy_market_items_hint: Pick an item to compare prices across cities.
economy_cities_hint: Cities out of sight show the last prices you saw. Goods bought where you have no storage stay there until you ship them.
economy_chart_label: {item} in {city}: 30-minute candles over 24 hours, high {high}, low {low}
economy_book_observed: This city is out of sight. Prices as seen {time}.
economy_sum_unfilled: {qty} won't fill within your price limit
economy_sum_conditional: Places a limit order when triggered. Funds are held at that point.
economy_sum_tax_note: The seller pays the sales tax.
economy_limit_help: Assign units with higher INT and WIS to the exchange to raise your order limit.
economy_limit_reached_at: Order limit reached. You can order again at {time}.
economy_submit_hint: The exchange isn't open yet, so orders can't be sent. The figures above are a preview.
economy_no_warehouse: You have no storage in this city. Goods you buy stay here until you ship them.
economy_exchange_intro: Currencies trade against the base currency ({base}). Orders are collected and matched together at one price on a schedule.
economy_placeholder_pack: Placeholder content pack. Items and values aren't game design.
screen_soon_section: Opening soon. Real data will show here once the rules are ready.
screen_soon_pressed: This opens soon. No command was sent.
screen_preview_switch_hint: Dev and admin only. Same switch as Home.
faction_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. It isn't a real faction, and buttons won't send commands.
faction_none_body: Found a family or join a faction to see its details here.
faction_rule_leader: The ruling family's head decides alone. There are no votes.
faction_rule_per_family: Each member family casts one vote.
faction_rule_by_shares: Votes are weighted by the city shares you hold.
faction_me_no_owner: You have no world record yet. It's created when you enter the map.
faction_locks_hint: Each opens once its conditions are met.
faction_city_threshold: Rebellion at {value} or less · warning at {warning}
faction_dip_scores_hint: Relation (favor) differs for each pair of factions. Faction trust is one value per faction that everyone sees, and it drops when a treaty is broken.
faction_treaty_offers_hint_vote: Alliance, protectorate, territory transfer, ceasefire and peace go to a vote. Ceasefire and peace votes are short. The leader signs the other treaties directly.
faction_treaty_offers_hint_leader: Under a dictatorship, the head of the ruling family signs every treaty directly.
faction_war_declare_hint: Declaring without a cause badly hurts relations with every faction and costs treasury funds.
faction_war_deadline_rule: If no time is picked within 24 hours of the siege declaration, the siege opens at this time.
faction_dividend_rule: Dividends come from city tax: issue interest is burned first, then city running costs are paid, and the remaining profit is split every {period}: by shares under capitalism, by shares under dictatorship with the treasury's part going to the ruling family, and all kept in the treasury under democracy.
faction_share_dividend_treasury: No dividend (remaining profit goes to the treasury)
faction_share_dividend_ruling: The treasury's part goes to the ruling family
faction_path_share_vote: The top-holding family opens a vote. It passes with 50%+ of shares, or is declared outright by a family holding 50% alone.
faction_path_family_vote: One vote per family in the city; a majority means independence.
faction_path_rebellion_only: There's no independence vote; only a rebellion breaks away.
faction_path_none_start_city: Start cities have no independence vote.
faction_occ_offer_hint: Accept to keep your building shares and join the occupier. Refuse or let it expire and you lose your assets there, get driven out and become hostile to the occupier, a target for attack.
faction_occ_restoration_hint: Anyone can contribute, and contributions become shares of this city in proportion ({count} per city).
faction_occ_restoration_mine: You gave {amount} {currency} · about {shares} shares once the goal is met
faction_occ_state_loot: Government fallen · storage open to the looter until rebuilt · rebuild possible {time}
faction_occ_state_occupy: Regime kept, finances to the occupier · recovers on its own {time}
faction_occ_end_owner_changed: Ended when the city changed hands
faction_occ_end_replaced: Replaced by a newer siege outcome
faction_occ_end_expired: The slow recovery period has ended
mail_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. Send and claim buttons won't send commands.
mail_empty_inbox_hint: Items or faction currency that other cyborgs send you arrive here. Rewards and notices come as to-dos, not mail.
mail_recipient_hint: Cyborg names are unique on the server, so the name alone is enough.
mail_attach_hint: Units, Terra Coins and account-bound items can't be sent. Up to {count} attachments.
mail_attach_none: You don't have any items or faction currency to send yet.
mail_send_soon: Everything checks out. Sending opens soon — nothing was sent.
mail_err_text_invalid: Contains characters that can't be used.
dev_tool_tuning_desc: See the planning setting cells (49), change them live in this world and export the changes as a pack diff
dev_tuning_lead: Changes apply to this world right away (the pack stays as is). Edit values to stage them, then press [Apply] in the bar below to send them together.
dev_tuning_page_all_lead: Every cell, grouped by design code. Pick an area to see only that area's cells.
dev_tuning_page_society_lead: Occupation and loot shares, satisfaction targets and recovery, incorporation deadline, rebellion thresholds, lifespan, tech levels and development, fatigue, wages, recruit cards, temples, ruin restoration.
dev_tuning_page_npc_lead: NPC trait axes, decision interval, tax rules, decision score weights, world seed (start cities, base facilities, day and night work).
dev_tuning_page_gardener_lead: How cell pollution grows, fades and spreads; wave chance, strength and warning; nomad bands; gardener relations; travel raids.
dev_tuning_page_holdings_lead: Gear wear, repair loss, ammo refill loss, potion and food cooldowns, auto-potion threshold, spoil speed per storage place.
dev_tuning_page_combat_lead: Battle time limits, retreat, bush and height sight, element affinity, evasion, crits and stamina, life regen, injury stages and hospitals.
dev_tuning_page_economy_lead: Gathering tiers and progress, raw-material objects, building construction and ageing, labour contracts, NPC central bank.
dev_tuning_page_other_lead: Cyborg creation, growth, rebirth and grants; fusion and genes; rankings; territory; operator switches.
dev_tuning_search_placeholder: Code, ID, name, description or source
dev_tuning_scope_live_hint: The server uses it from the next request
dev_tuning_scope_sim_hint: The server does not read it yet. Only the simulator and exports use it
dev_tuning_reloaded: Someone changed values first, so the list was reloaded. Check the staged changes and apply again.
dev_tuning_err_unknown_entry: That cell is not in the pack.
dev_tuning_err_out_of_range: A value is outside its technical range.
dev_tuning_err_invalid_note: Notes are up to 200 characters with no hidden characters.
dev_tuning_err_duplicate_entry: The same cell was staged twice.
dev_tuning_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
dev_tuning_err_forbidden: This account cannot manage setting cells.
dev_tuning_err_unavailable: This server has no tuning panel (no database or sign-in).
dev_tuning_problem_n9_fit: N9: the stat sum must be between min × 6 and max × 6
dev_tuning_problem_n36_fit: N36: 1 to 4 element cells, points ≤ cells × 10
dev_tuning_problem_fatigue_order: N21·N23: fatigue band starts rise and stay at or below the maximum
dev_tuning_problem_food_order: N33: food zero threshold ≤ low threshold
dev_tuning_problem_n45_fit: N45: recruit cards per level — card count and total stats min ≤ max (at most 16 cards, total at least 6), 1–4 elements, element points fit the element count (1–10 per element)
dev_tuning_problem_stat_sum_cap: Initial stat sums: cyborg sum (N9) and human/creature max ≤ 100, recruit totals and gene total cap ≤ human max, condition cap ≥ 0 (D-534)
dev_tuning_confirm_structural_body: {count} staged cells are structural values set by decisions (D-5054). Apply them anyway?
dev_tuning_confirm_revert_all_body: Return {count} changed cells to their pack values. This is recorded in the audit log.
dev_tuning_export_body: {count} cells. Put them into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply <file>, which bumps the pack version.
dev_tuning_copy_failed: Could not copy. Copy it from the text box.
dev_tuning_history_dropped: Removed (does not fit the new pack)
dev_tuning_cells_summary: {total} cells in 49 · {connected} wired · {noValue} without a value · {notConnected} not wired
dev_tuning_cells_note: A read-only list built from the planning document 49. Names are the Korean names from 49.
dev_tuning_problem_stat_primary_unused: Stat weights: a primary stat would have zero weight in every row (a worthless primary)
dev_tool_balance_desc: Build teams, units and gear, run N real battles (party, siege, wave, A/B) and keep reports on win rate, damage, hit, evade, crit and the damage flow
dev_tool_secondary_stats_desc: Edit secondary stat weights and formulas; see primary influence, archetype level curves, K spread bands, probability diminishing returns, per-weapon stamina and appropriate stats, and +10 duel win rates.
dev_sec_lead: Adjust weights or custom formulas per secondary stat and preview physical, talent, magic, and balanced progression charts live. Walk speed (D-540) is excluded.
dev_sec_walk_speed_excluded: Walk speed (walk_speed) is managed separately and excluded here.
dev_sec_show_inactive: Show replaced reference rows (hit, crit_chance, action_speed)
dev_sec_weight_hint: Edit ‰ weights, base, cap, or half-constant to update all charts immediately.
dev_sec_formula_hint: Edits are syntax- and variable-checked and reflected immediately in charts.
dev_sec_chart_influence_title: Primary stat influence: formula weight · share in this unit's distribution
dev_sec_chart_weight_title: Formula weight — how the formula counts each stat (each +10 with every primary at {level})
dev_sec_chart_weight_hint: This bar is the counting ratio. It looks only at the formula, not at any unit's stats. A 1:1 formula such as AGI + DEX shows two equal bars.
dev_sec_chart_share_title: Share in this unit's distribution — the part of the current value each stat makes
dev_sec_chart_share_hint: How much the value drops if that stat were 0. Even with a 1:1 formula, the stat that grew more in this distribution (for example DEX for Talent) shows larger. It is not the counting ratio.
dev_sec_chart_plus10_hint: +10 Δ: how much the value changes if only that stat rises by 10 at this distribution.
dev_sec_formula_none: The formula could not be read (formula error).
dev_sec_chart_curves_desc: Physical, Talent, Magic, and Balanced builds (solid: draft, dashed: baseline)
dev_sec_chart_kband_desc: Shaded spread between min/mid/max K for {archetype}
dev_sec_chart_prob_desc: Approaches cap asymptotically; reaches 50% of cap at the half-constant score.

dev_skills_cond_appropriate_met: STR or INT at or above the weapon's appropriate
dev_skills_costs_lead: Every action except walking costs stamina (D-418). These are base values; actual cost = value × max(minimum, appropriate STA ÷ STA score), where appropriate STA follows level (D-511). [Apply] takes effect at once.
dev_skills_basis_lead: A unit whose primaries all start at 10 and grow with level (D-511 appropriate-stat concept). Appropriate STA = formula stamina_appropriate (by level); actual regen = secondary stamina regen × min(2, STA score ÷ appropriate STA) (formula real_stamina_regen). If a cost per second below is higher than regen, basic attacks stall. Tune the values here, on the formula tab and in the weight table.
dev_skills_mp_basic_hint: MP is spent only when the basic attack field is elemental
dev_content_export_hint: Apply this file to the pack in the repository with pnpm tuning:apply <file> and commit it (it carries settings and editor changes together).

dev_skills_rebase_conflicts: Fields changed on both sides (your value kept): {fields}
dev_skills_section_basic_desc: Names and descriptions shown on screen (Korean and English) and whether it is on. A disabled skill is dropped from combat data even if equipment points to it.
dev_skills_enabled_desc: When off, combat does not use it.
dev_skills_section_weapon_desc: Which stat line's attack it scales with and which damage type it deals (chosen separately), and what must be held to use it. Bare-handed units can only use bare-hand skills.
dev_skills_base_desc: Which stat line the attack and appropriate stat use: STR·VIT (weapon physical field) or INT·WIS (weapon elemental field). Chosen separately from the damage type (D-568).
dev_skills_damage_desc: How the target takes the damage (physical hits armour first, elemental hits shields first). Independent of the stat line — a STR magic sword deals elemental damage, an INT mace deals physical damage. None = no damage (heal or buff).
dev_skills_section_target_desc: Changing the shape adjusts target, radius, chain and heal parts to fit it (same rules as the pack validator).
dev_skills_shape_desc: Single, projectile, area, chain, heal, buff or debuff.
dev_skills_trigger_desc: Passive only works with the buff shape.
dev_skills_range_desc: Maximum distance to the target. Projectiles need 2 or more.
dev_skills_field_range_interval: Range budget (longer range, longer action interval)
dev_skills_range_interval_hint: On by default for attack skills (D-573: the same range-for-speed trade-off as weapons, physical or elemental). Action interval after this skill (the longer of cast time and attack interval) × (1 + (skill range − 1) × per-cell share), up to the cap. The weapon share applies to basic attacks only. Turning it off removes it from curves (or writes curves: []). Values are the moves_range_interval_* settings.
dev_skills_radius_desc: Radius hit by the area shape (0 for single, projectile and chain).
dev_skills_section_cost_desc: Resource and time it costs. Actual cost = base cost × stamina score multiplier (settings N13 formula).
dev_skills_section_formula_desc: Parts that set damage, heal and shield amounts (attack multiplier, weapon attack bonus, element coefficient, penetration, flat damage, heal, shield).
dev_skills_section_conditions_desc: Conditions for using this skill (appropriate stats met, own HP, target HP, effect on the target).
dev_skills_section_effects_desc: Effects applied to the target (picked from the effect dictionary): chance, duration (empty = dictionary value) and magnitude.
dev_skills_section_grades_desc: Strength multiplier per skill grade (1000 = unchanged).

dev_terrain_objects_tier_max_label: {name} tier range high (T0 to T9, all terrains)
dev_terrain_objects_add_label: Object to add to this terrain
dev_terrain_objects_exported: Downloaded terrain-objects-diff.json. Apply it to the pack with pnpm tuning:apply terrain-objects-diff.json.
dev_tool_gather_objects_desc: Edit each gather object's 3D model, main item (raw material kind), amount, tier range and the 2nd-map terrains it appears on, then export a diff (D-552).

dev_gather_objects_failed: Could not load pack entries. Check your permissions and the server.
dev_gather_objects_model_rock: Stands on rock-face cells and uses the terrain art as is.

dev_gather_objects_kind: Raw material kind: {kind} ladder · main item T{tier}
dev_gather_objects_table_hint: A roll-table object does not roll a tier; it yields one of these by weight. Edit the table in the pack.
dev_gather_objects_tiers_hint: The tier rolled from the table is clamped to this range. If the main item is in that tier, the main item comes out.

dev_gather_objects_tiers_table: Roll-table objects have no tier range.
dev_gather_objects_terrain_prop: Stands wherever its prop art is placed (the prop rules decide the terrain).
dev_gather_objects_terrain_rock: Stands on that share of rock-face blocks.
dev_gather_objects_preview_hint: Computed from the gather table (one table), then the tier range, then the main item. Building gatherers (farm, ranch, herb garden) use no objects, so this only covers direct gathering.
dev_gather_objects_exported: Downloaded gather-objects-diff.json. Put it into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply gather-objects-diff.json.

dev_effects_pick: Pick an effect in the table to edit it here.
dev_effects_primary_hint: Primary stat buffs (food buffs, D-472) aren't read by combat yet; the consumption runtime will use them.
dev_effects_exclusive_hint: Exclusive group (D-472, D-501): one effect per unit per group (e.g. food). The same effect keeps the higher value; a different effect replaces it after a confirm dialog. Automatic use switches only when better for the situation and never uses one when an equal or better one is active. The consumption runtime applies it.
dev_effects_usage_none: No items or skills use this effect.
dev_effects_page_lead: The effect dictionary shared by item use effects and skill effect rows (D-425). Edits go into staged changes and [Apply] sends them in the same batch as the item editor. Once applied, both editors' effect pickers and the next combat data use them.
dev_effects_new_lead: The new effect is staged switched off so a half-made effect never reaches combat. Fill in the fields, switch it on, then apply.
dev_effects_section_basic_desc: Display names (Korean and English), effect kind, the stat it changes, value mode, and on/off. Disabled effects show "Disabled" in pickers and drop out of combat data.
dev_effects_section_time_desc: Default duration (used when an effect row leaves duration empty), tick (interval for damage or healing over time), how re-application stacks, and max stacks.
dev_effects_section_status_desc: Status kind and the resistance computed from primary stats (D-429): cap ‰, half constant, and a weight ‰ per stat.
dev_effects_section_usage_desc: Items (use effect rows) and skills (effect rows and "target has this effect" conditions) that use this effect. Select one to open it in its editor.
dev_effects_pick_hint: Pick an effect in the list or press [New effect].
dev_effects_revert_staged_note: A revert is staged. [Apply] removes the override (a created effect is deleted).
dev_effects_reloaded: Someone changed it first, so the list was reloaded. Your edits are kept.

dev_items_tags_empty: No tags yet. Create them under [Item classes].

dev_items_world_price_none: No market price — the server market is not open yet (the start price becomes the first price)
dev_items_lot_hint: Market orders, prices and recipe amounts are per lot; storage and transport use base units (empty = 1)
dev_items_lot_hint_weight: One lot = {size} · market orders, prices and recipe amounts are per lot; storage and transport use base units
dev_items_bare_hand_hint: Raw materials T0–T1 only. When on, other building materials in the same subcategory count for it (basic buildings, area modules). Turn it on for a subcategory to include all of it.
dev_items_bare_hand_sub_hint: When on, every T0–T1 item in this raw subcategory counts as a level 0 building material (like wood). To pick only some, turn it on per item.
dev_items_issue_bare_hand_raw: Level 0 building material is only for raw T0–T1 items (and raw subcategories).
dev_items_bound_hint: Turning this on turns trading off.
dev_items_durability_hint: Wears every battle, more on a loss (D-496 289; amounts are settings d496_wear_*). Actual wear runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_slot_no_wearer: No enabled unit kind has this slot.
dev_items_field_kinds: Unit kinds that can wear it
dev_items_kinds_hint: Empty means every kind with that slot. Only listed kinds wear it (combat, preview and lab filter, D-494).
dev_items_creature_hint: Weight and steal chance when creatures carry it (D-494, used by the creature editor).
dev_items_stats_primary: Primary stat rows (this slot raises primaries only)
dev_items_stats_secondary: Secondary rows (except the two attack rows)
dev_items_elements_hint: 1–10 per element (D-450). Unit element = sum of sources, capped at 10 per cell (used in combat).
dev_items_combat_hint: 12 resistances, flat defense, penetration (D-421). Values from several items add up (D-178, used in combat).
dev_items_skill_unusable_here: Cannot be used with this weapon's attack fields (D-490).
dev_items_damage_hint: The field is the stat line (physical field = STR·VIT, elemental field = INT·WIS); the damage type is chosen separately (D-568: a STR magic sword deals elemental damage, an INT mace deals physical damage).
dev_items_range_interval_hint: On by default for every weapon (answer to question 1814, D-557). Basic attack interval × (1 + (range − 1) × per-cell share), up to the cap. Turning it off writes curves: []. Values are the moves_range_interval_* settings.
dev_items_appropriate_hint: Not an equip requirement. One stat per part: STR for the physical field, INT for the elemental field, DEX for hit and crit, AGI for the attack interval. Falling short scales that part down (the interval gets longer); going over gives no bonus. Leave blank for 100% (D-502).
dev_items_cost_shared: Same value as the action cost table
dev_items_two_handed_hint: While held, the off-hand item is ignored (combat, preview, lab; never an error).
dev_items_ammo_hint: Ammo is one off-hand item whose durability is the rounds left (D-497). −1 per ranged hit, none at 0 — consumption runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_ammo_type_hint: Items of this off-hand type use durability as rounds left (D-497); each ranged hit uses one.
dev_items_ammo_capacity_hint: Ammo max durability = rounds held (D-497). Ammo exists only as this offhand gear (D-501). −1 per ranged hit, no ranged attacks at 0 — swap in other ammo gear. Consumption runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_use_hint: The same potion or food is one item; the amount follows the user's stat ÷ the appropriate stat ± variance (D-496 286, D-501). Using it runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_use_scale_hint: Amount = base × min(cap, user's stat ÷ appropriate stat) × (1 ± variance). The cap is setting N10, the same as weapon efficiency; variance is 250–500‰ per line (blank = setting, default 500‰). HP healing usually uses VIT, MP uses WIS (D-501).
dev_items_perish_hint: At zero it turns into the chosen item (D-496 288).
dev_items_preview_blocked: The draft has blocking problems, so nothing was computed.
dev_items_preview_overflow: The primary stat total is too large to compute.
dev_items_preview_no_slot: This kind has no such slot.
dev_items_preview_not_wearable: This kind isn't allowed to wear it, so it was left off (D-494).
dev_items_preview_rows_hint: Shows the six primaries and only secondary rows that change. Computed with the same functions as the unit screen.
dev_items_preview_weapon: Weapon (this world's effective formulas, middle roll)
dev_items_preview_use_runtime: Amounts use the sample unit's stats. Actually using items (including in combat) runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_gather_off: Disabled, so it never drops in this world.
dev_items_gather_shared: Shared with {n} enabled items of the same tier.
dev_items_gather_levels: Chance per lot at each facility level
dev_items_gather_table_caption: Tier chances by effective stat band
dev_items_gather_select: Building gatherer (D-566·D-567): each level grows tier 2 × level − 1 (Lv1 T1 … Lv5 T9). If {stats} {stat} is below the recommended sum (20 × tier), harvest efficiency drops (no roll, no level bonus).

dev_items_gather_work_formula: Progress = max(1, ⌊{primary} ÷ {divisor}⌋)/tick · per harvest {base} + ⌊{secondary} × {rate}⌋ (up to {cap}) · 1 progress = {tick}
dev_items_gather_work_grams: One ore = {grams} g (setting N44, one lot)
dev_items_gather_rows: Progress and yield by stat (primary = secondary)

dev_territory_lead: The planet territory map is the ruling (D-568): each city has a territory circle (current catchment × scale, with a minimum), land between nearby same-faction cities is included, and city-owned beacons push that city's and faction's outline out to the beacon. Where they overlap, the city with the lower influence ratio (distance ÷ circle size) takes the land, and it becomes that city's province. Beacons, new cities and villages can't go in another faction's territory. Buildings are blocked only in another faction's city (a second map with a government building); second maps without one are open to anyone even inside a territory (claim-staking, D-572). Dashed circle = urban area (grade reach ÷ 3). Beacon count and distance are settings cell N42, durability is N51, circle and link values are planet_territory_*.

ruins_rule_owner: On an unowned ruin site (where the nearest city or ruin to the cell is that ruin), whoever starts building a government hall first becomes the owner.
ruins_rule_fund: The owner can fund at any time; once the owner opens fundraising, anyone can. When the goal is met, the city returns and its 1,000 shares are split by contribution.
ruins_rule_dictatorship: In a dictatorship the ruling family keeps a majority of the shares.
ruins_no_cyborg: Create a cyborg to take part in ruin restoration.
ruins_build_hint: Build a government hall at cell {x}, {y} to become the owner.
ruins_build_no_room: No free cells nearby for a government hall.
ruins_claimed: Started a government hall on ruin #{id}. You are now the owner. Funding opens once it is finished.
ruins_shares_title: Shares if the goal were met now
ruins_opened: Opened fundraising for ruin #{id}. Anyone can contribute now.
ruins_fund_closed: You can contribute once the owner opens fundraising.
ruins_fund_short: Not enough of this currency. Buy it with the base currency at the exchange, then contribute.
ruins_restored: Goal met. City #{id} has been restored.
ruins_err_busy: The world is getting ready. Try again shortly.
ruins_err_unknown_ruin: No such ruin. It may already have been restored.
ruins_err_not_claimed: No owner yet. Build a government hall first.
ruins_err_not_owner: Only the owner can do this.
ruins_err_not_open: Fundraising is not open. Only the owner can contribute.
ruins_err_no_faction: There is no nation for the city to join.
ruins_err_timeout: No reply in time. Check the list again.
ruins_rule_hall: The government hall must be finished before funding opens. If it drops to 0% or disappears, whoever rebuilds it becomes the owner, and contributions stay in the project.
ruins_rule_goal: The goal scales with the old city's housing. When the deadline passes, every contribution is refunded and the ruin becomes ownerless again.
ruins_rule_level: A restored city's admin level is its government hall's level (up to Lv{max}).
ruins_hall_building: The government hall is under construction. Funding opens once it is finished.
ruins_hall_down: The government hall is at 0% or gone. Whoever rebuilds it becomes the owner.
ruins_rebuild_hint: Rebuild the government hall at cell {x}, {y} to become the owner. Contributions stay in the project.
ruins_fund_not_built: You can contribute once the government hall is finished.
ruins_fund_expired: The funding deadline has passed. Contributions are refunded at the end of the day.
ruins_dev_finish_done: The government hall is finished. Funding can open now.
recruit_intro: Hire humans with a city government office's recruit cards. New cards come out on a fixed schedule. Assign hired humans on a gathering facility card above.
recruit_no_cities: No city to recruit from yet.
recruit_meta: City {city} admin Lv{level} · your balance {amount} · new cards in {hours}h {minutes}m
recruit_no_cards: No cards in this city right now.
recruit_hired: Hired a human (unit #{unit}). Assign it on a gathering facility card.
government_load_failed: Could not load the government screen. Try opening it again.
government_leader_desk_hint: The leader is this nation's government desk. See the capital government's facts and recruit cards, plus diplomacy, quests and citizenship.
government_day_note: All three are values from the same day, counted at the end of each day (00:00 UTC). — means there is no value yet.
government_desk_diplomacy_note: See relations and wars between nations under Diplomacy on the faction screen.
government_desk_quests_note: This nation has no quests yet. Offers and job matches you receive gather in your inbox.
government_desk_citizenship_note: This is your nation's government. Apply for naturalization at another nation's government.
government_mayor_baseline: No stored stats yet, so the baseline (all 10) is shown.
government_recruit_hint: Hire humans with this city's government recruit cards. Hired humans appear around this city.
naturalize_lead: Apply to this nation's government to become its citizen. You pay the entrance fee or receive the grant this nation sets. Nothing goes back to your old nation, but your standing with it drops.
naturalize_standing_hostile: This nation is at war with {nation}, so your standing with your old nation drops sharply.
naturalize_keeps: Your units, buildings, jobs and hired humans stay yours. Your home city becomes this city, and you won't get a settlement grant again.
naturalize_block_same: You are already a citizen of this nation.
naturalize_block_in_house: House members can't naturalize. Your nation is the nation of your house's home city. A leader changes the home city; a member leaves the house first.
naturalize_block_not_joinable: This nation isn't accepting new citizens right now.
naturalize_block_captive: Your cyborg is held captive, so you can't apply.
naturalize_block_wrong_city: Your cyborg must be in this city to apply.
naturalize_block_resting: Rest period. You can naturalize again {time}.
naturalize_confirm_pay: Become a citizen of {nation}? You pay an entrance fee of {amount}.
naturalize_confirm_receive: Become a citizen of {nation}? You receive a grant of {amount}.
naturalize_done: You are now a citizen of {nation}.
naturalize_err_busy: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
naturalize_err_rate_limited: Too many applications. Try again shortly.
naturalize_err_internal: Couldn't process the application. Try again.
naturalize_err_not_government: You can't apply for naturalization at this building.
naturalize_err_resting: You're in the rest period and can't change nationality yet.
naturalize_err_terms_changed: The terms have changed. Check the new terms and apply again.
naturalize_err_offline: Disconnected from the server. Apply again once you're back online.
naturalize_err_timeout: No reply yet. Check the terms again.
market_err_busy: The city economy is still starting. Try again shortly.
market_err_paused: The exchange is paused for maintenance.
market_err_unknown_city: That city doesn't exist. It may have fallen to ruin.
market_err_unknown_item: This item isn't traded on the exchange.
market_err_unknown_order: That order doesn't exist. It may already be filled or closed.
market_err_goods: Not enough of this item in your warehouse in that city.
market_err_invalid_amount: That value can't be used. Check the price, quantity and expiry.
market_err_order_limit: You've reached the open order limit. Cancel an order or wait for one to fill.
market_err_no_liquidity: No orders to match within your price limit.
market_err_timeout: No reply in time. Check your orders again.
fx_err_unknown_currency: This currency can't be exchanged (no nation issues it).
fx_err_funds: Not enough balance. Buying locks the base currency; selling locks that currency.
fx_err_order_limit: You've reached the order limit for this round. Withdraw an order or wait for the round to close.
fx_placed: Order placed. It clears in the round in {time}; anything left is returned.
fx_open_empty: You have no orders in this round.
fx_intro_live: City markets price goods in that city's nation currency. Swap the base currency (settlement grant, wages) into it to buy, and swap sales back. The indicative price includes the quotes the nation posts every round (last price ±2%).
market_conditional_soon: Conditional orders aren't open yet. Choose limit or market.
market_city_production_note: Production run by the city's NPC facilities and city jobs (work humans do without a building). Surplus goods go on that city's exchange.
market_city_production_empty: Nothing is being produced in this city yet.
gather_object_ladder: Yields: {ladder} ladder — the tier is rolled from the gathering unit's stats
gather_object_ladder_tiers: Yields: {ladder} ladder T{min}–T{max} — the tier is rolled from the gathering unit's stats; tiers outside the range come out at its nearest end
gather_object_facility: Within a {facility}'s reach you deposit there and gather more
gather_object_direct: No facility handles this: carry it to storage or a city
gather_object_station_only: Only facility workers harvest this. Build the facility nearby and assign workers.
gather_object_boat_only: Reachable only by boat. Pick a unit aboard a boat and press [Gather]: the boat sails next to it and fishes (fishing spot workers on the shore catch schools that swim into range).
gather_object_from_boat: Gathered from the boat. The boat sails next to it, and the passenger carries the catch until it is stored at a nearby warehouse.
gather_object_not_from_boat: From a boat you can only gather sea objects (fish schools, wrecks, whale pods, vents). Leave the boat first.
gather_object_details: {lots} lot(s) per gather · base work {seconds} s · regrows in {regrow}
gather_actor_none: No unit to send. Select one of your units.
gather_stop_interrupted: Gathering was interrupted by another order
gather_stop_no_deposit: No place to deposit on this map (facility, storehouse or city)
gather_enter_assigned: Entered and took a job there
gather_error_forbidden: You can only send your own units
gather_error_wrong_map: The unit is on another map
gather_error_unavailable: That unit cannot move now (working, injured or captured)
gather_error_retry: Cannot send now. Try again shortly
gather_building_hires: Entering takes a job at this facility
station_disabled: Condition too low to work. Needs repair.
station_facility_note: This facility produces without resource objects. Output collects in station storage, then moves to city storage.
station_objects_none: No resources this station handles within the radius. Workers cannot gather.
station_haul_done: Sent to city storage. If it is far, a worker carries the load on foot.
station_haul_off: Auto-move is off. Move goods by hand.
station_haul_no_city: Outside a city — no city storage to move to.
station_haul_route_store: {cells} cells to the storehouse · current load takes {time}
station_haul_route_city: No storehouse, {cells} cells to the city centre · current load takes {time}
station_haul_porter: unit {id} is carrying the load, reaches city storage in {time}
station_haul_no_porter: No worker to carry the load. Put a worker at this station and they will walk it to city storage.
station_rest_hint: Workers rest in free lodging beds in this city. Without a bed they recover more slowly at home and work fewer hours a day.
station_workers_note: Workers gather resources within the radius and store them right here. Only units on this map can work here.
station_workers_note_facility: Workers produce on site and store output right here. Only units on this map can work here.
station_gather_none: No resources ready within the radius.
station_grow_tier: Grows T{tier} inside the building (level tier). Below a worker main + sub sum of {stat}, harvests shrink · area {area}%
station_plots_remove: Remove one module (materials are not returned)
station_tier_hint: Pick at or below the highest tier set by the building level. Lower tiers need lower stats, so weaker workers harvest at full efficiency.
station_plots_full: All module slots are used. Level up for more.
injury_rule: Injuries heal by themselves one stage at a time: critical {red} → serious {yellow} → light {white} → normal. No hospital is needed.
injury_red_note: A critically injured unit can't take orders.
hospital_lead: Hospitals heal much faster depending on their level and the doctor's INT + WIS and healing skill, and they cost money. Only hospitals in the city where this unit stands are shown.
hospital_not_ready: Hospitals open when the world is ready.
hospital_none_here: No hospital can treat this unit in the city where it stands. Build a hospital in Economy → Production and assign a doctor.
hospital_doctor: Doctor #{id} · INT + WIS {stat} · healing skill grade {grade}
hospital_no_doctor: No doctor — assign a unit to the hospital to speed it up
hospital_not_faster: Already in care at least this fast.
hospital_err_busy: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
hospital_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
hospital_err_closed: The hospital is being built or has stopped (condition below 30%).
hospital_err_wrong_city: The unit isn't in the hospital's city.
hospital_err_cost_changed: The price changed. Check the new price.
facility_workers_rule_medical: Doctors: the best assigned unit's INT + WIS and healing skill raise the healing speed. No goods are produced.
ops_res_not_standable: The unit cannot stand on that cell.
ops_res_unsupported_kind: Not supported for this unit kind (server bots, etc.).
ops_res_self: You cannot do this to your own account.
ops_res_protected_target: Only admins can ban admin accounts.
ops_res_insufficient: Cannot revoke more than the balance.
ops_grants_note: Role defaults cannot be removed. Checkboxes only take effect for accounts with a console role (operator, developer, admin).
ops_grants_no_console: This account has no console role, so checkboxes have no effect.
ops_unit_remove_note: Unit removal is not available yet (needs per-kind cleanup).
scope_load_failed: Could not load the planet list.
scope_note_common: Saved as this world's override and applied to every planet alike.
scope_note_tuning: Settings exist once per world. A change applies to every planet alike.
scope_note_balance: Formulas and weights exist once per world and apply to every planet alike.
scope_note_nations: Nation presets and faction identity exist once per world. Pick the planet a nation sits on in World Layout.
scope_note_world_layout: Nation homes are placed on the chosen planet only (applied at the next server start).
scope_note_territory: Shows territory and beacons of the chosen planet only; beacons are placed on that planet.
scope_note_recruit: Recruits in cities of the chosen planet.
scope_note_second_map: Views local maps of the chosen planet (view only; the world is not changed).
scope_note_ops: Filters factions, cities, units and the audit log by the chosen planet.
scope_note_star_system: Saves to star system drafts only (library planets placed on orbits).
scope_note_battle_replay: A demo battle. World data is not changed.
scope_note_device: Measured on this device only; nothing is saved.
scope_note_accounts: Accounts and permissions exist once for the whole world.
scope_tab_world: This tab is not filtered by planet (whole world).
dev_tool_creatures_desc: Edit creatures, circular portrait crops, stat auto-allocation, innate weapon roll ranges, and loot tables, then apply live
dev_tool_nations_desc: Edit starting NPC nations: names, currency, emblems, start cities and population, then apply live
dev_nations_lead: Overrides the pack's nation presets for this world. Changes apply at once; start numbers affect cities founded from now on.
dev_nations_world_off: This server seeds no NPC nations
dev_nations_reverting: Applying will revert this nation to the pack values.
dev_nations_rebased: Your fields were put back on top of someone else's change. Check and apply again.
dev_nations_section_identity_desc: Name, short name, signature colour, leader and emblem. Names must be fictional (no real countries, places or people).
dev_nations_section_currency_desc: Currency name, symbol, 3-letter ticker and trade tax. The code is the ledger asset name and cannot change.
dev_nations_section_start_desc: Start city count, city names and the first warehouse stock.
dev_nations_section_people_desc: Housing, first population and starter facilities per start city, plus human names. Empty fields use the settings value.
dev_nations_section_traits_desc: Specialities the NPC city economy reads (city jobs). Humans run these recipes in cities without that facility.
dev_nations_future_note: These numbers only affect start cities founded later and missing facilities or people. Existing cities do not change.
dev_nations_field_style_desc: The syllable table used by the name generator. Not used by game rules.
dev_nations_field_short_desc: 2–5 letters or digits. Must differ between nations.
dev_nations_field_intro_desc: Short intro on the first-login nation cards. Describe the fictional nation's mood; no real countries or people.
dev_nations_color_contrast: Contrast with map backgrounds: light {light} · dark {dark}
dev_nations_color_warn: This colour is hard to tell from the map background. Pick one of the readable colours above.
dev_nations_field_currency_code_hint: Ledger asset name; cannot be changed.
dev_nations_field_ticker_desc: Three capital letters. Must differ between currencies.
dev_nations_field_trade_tax_desc: Basis points (200 = 2%). NPC tax rules may change it later.
dev_nations_field_start_cities_desc: With a tier: 1–{max}. Without: clamped to the settings range {min}–{max}.
dev_nations_field_necessity_hours_desc: Necessities a city gets once = humans × this many hours.
dev_nations_field_city_names_hint: Start cities take these from the top. Names are not translated.
dev_nations_field_start_stock_hint: Amount one NPC city receives once (in lots).
dev_nations_field_housing: Housing of a new start city
dev_nations_field_housing_desc: Housing when the city is founded. NPC society grows it afterwards.
dev_nations_field_population_pm_desc: Humans a start city gets once = housing × this share.
dev_nations_population_result: Housing {housing} → {people} people per city, {total} across {cities} cities
dev_nations_facilities_note: Farms, lumber camps and mines are only built where the land suits them (thresholds are in settings).
dev_nations_fixed_none: Not seeded (one leader per nation — combat units are the guards above)
dev_nations_field_human_names_hint: Human name = given + family, fixed per unit (not translated).
dev_nations_field_city_jobs_hint: Pair a facility with one of its recipes. Earlier rows come first.
dev_nations_namegen_note: Candidates are seeded fictional names. Check they do not match a real place or person before picking.
dev_nations_preview_counts: {cities} start cities · housing {housing} each · {people} people each · up to {facilities} starter facilities
dev_nations_emblem_note: The generated emblem is staged and applied like other fields. An uploaded image takes priority in this world.
dev_nations_emblem_uploaded_note: The uploaded image is shown first. Uploads apply at once and are not part of the pack export.
dev_nations_emblem_unreadable: Could not read the image. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
dev_nations_emblem_removed_done: Uploaded emblem removed. The generated emblem is shown.
dev_nations_crop_view: Crop area. Drag or use arrow keys to move, + and − to zoom.
dev_nations_crop_hint: Cropped to a square and uploaded as a {size} × {size} PNG. Below: how it looks at 24, 48 and 128px.
dev_nations_error_emblem_too_large: The image is too large (200,000 bytes at most). Choose a simpler image.
dev_nations_error_world_unavailable: Not available on this server (no database).
dev_nations_field_tier_desc: The tier row sets the defaults for start cities, housing, first population, facilities, guards, tech, treasury and spacing. Values entered for this nation win.
dev_nations_field_guards_desc: Standing combat humans seeded in each start city. They are not workers, stay around the government hall and defend first when the city is attacked.
dev_nations_field_tech_desc: Tech level when the nation is first founded (feeds unit combat stats). Never lowered for a nation that already stands.
dev_nations_power_title: Power tiers: start totals by nation and the tier table
dev_nations_power_lead: Start totals, strongest tier first. Bars are relative to the largest value and follow staged edits.
dev_nations_power_caption: {nations} nations in total: {cities} cities · {people} first population · {guards} guards
dev_nations_tier_table_note: Tier values apply to nations and start cities founded from now on. A standing world changes only through [Apply to this world] on the world layout screen.
dev_nations_tier_facilities: Facilities per start city (only those the land allows are built)
dev_nations_random_lead: A candidate with a random name, colour, emblem and tier. Roll until you like it, then add it. You can still edit it like any other nation.
dev_nations_random_same_name: This name matches an existing nation. Re-roll the nation name.
dev_nations_random_note: Adding stages a new preset (new ID, end of the list). Applying does not found it in this world: place it on the world layout screen and it is founded at the next server start.
dev_nations_error_nation_standing: A preset whose nation stands in this world, or has a home placed, cannot be removed.
dev_nations_issue_short_format: Short name: 2–5 letters or digits, no spaces.
dev_nations_issue_name_format: Names cannot be empty or start or end with spaces.
dev_nations_issue_given_empty: At least one given name is needed.
dev_nations_issue_intro_length: Keep the intro to {max} characters per language.
dev_nations_apply_open: Apply to this world's NPC nations…
dev_nations_apply_title: Apply to this world's NPC nations
dev_nations_apply_lead: Rewrites the already fixed faction names, short names, colours and currency display from the current presets. Rows an operator edited by hand are skipped. Units, cities and balances do not change.
dev_nations_apply_dirty: Staged changes must be applied first. This preview uses the saved values.
dev_nations_apply_plan: Preview: {updated} rows to change, {skipped} to skip (nothing changed yet)
dev_nations_apply_empty: No NPC nation has a fixed identity in this world yet. They will take the current preset values when first seen.
dev_nations_apply_action_skip_taken: Skipped: short name or ticker taken
dev_creature_crop_lead: Only a circle on the source image (centre X·Y, radius) is stored. What is inside the picker's circle is the portrait. Changing the image estimates the head position.
dev_creature_crop_help: Drag inside the circle to move it; press outside to centre there. Resize with the handle, two fingers, the size slider, or the wheel after pressing the image. Arrow keys = 1 px (Shift 10 px), + − = size, Ctrl+Z = undo.
dev_creature_crop_empty: Pick an image to choose the portrait circle.
dev_creature_crop_failed: Could not load the image. Check the file name.
dev_tool_ops_grants_desc: Grant extra operator-console permissions per account with checkboxes (role defaults are locked). Developers only
admin_log_lead: View-only events are not recorded by default (so development data does not pile up). Account, operator-control and editor-save records are always kept.
admin_log_view_audit_sub: Record one audit line every time someone opens the full second-map view or reads planet definitions.
audit_view_off_note: View records (full map view, planet definitions) are only kept while the log switch on the admin page is on.
dev_tool_world_layout_desc: Place fixed NPC nations on the planet map. Placements take effect on the next server start
dev_world_layout_lead: Pick a nation, tap the map to choose a spot, then press Place here. Placements take effect on the next server start. A nation whose cities hold player buildings, workers or units is not moved, and the reasons are shown. The NPC chooses and moves its capital by development.
dev_world_layout_not_ready: The world is not ready yet (waiting for the database and planet values).
dev_world_layout_map_failed: Could not load the planet map. Homes are still listed in the table.
dev_world_layout_map_label: Flat planet map: tap to choose a nation home
dev_world_layout_pick: Tap the map to choose a spot.
dev_world_layout_suggest_none: Nothing to suggest (every nation has a placement).
dev_world_layout_suggest_shown: Showing {count} suggested homes as dashed rings on the map.
dev_world_layout_placed: Placed {nation}. It takes effect on the next server start.
dev_world_layout_placed_snapped: Placed {nation} on the nearest suitable land. It takes effect on the next server start.
dev_world_layout_placed_found: Home placed for {nation}. It is founded in this world at the next server start.
dev_world_layout_tier_lead: Homes and start counts follow each nation preset's power tier: strong nations take wide land far apart, small states sit between larger neighbours.
dev_world_layout_plan_summary: {nations} nations · closest capitals {gap} cells (scaled by tier gap) · search radius {region} cells · cities short of room {short}
dev_world_layout_apply_title: Apply to this world (a standing world)
dev_world_layout_apply_will: Added: missing start cities around the capital, housing, first population and guards in start cities, tech level (raise only). Applied once at the next server start.
dev_world_layout_apply_wont: Unchanged: nothing is deleted or moved. Cities and population above the tier, treasuries, cities that changed owner and anything a player owns stay as they are.
dev_world_layout_apply_reset_note: To also match homes to the tier plan, use [Place all suggestions] (nations with player assets stay) or reset the world.
dev_world_layout_apply_surplus_note: {count} start cities above the tier are not removed. A clean match needs a world reset.
dev_world_layout_apply_pending: Scheduled ({when}) — applied at the next server start.
dev_world_layout_apply_requested: Apply scheduled. It takes effect at the next server start.
dev_world_layout_apply_nothing: Nothing to add. This world already matches the tiers.
dev_world_layout_found_group: Nations that can be founded here
dev_world_layout_found_title: Found a nation in this world
dev_world_layout_found_note: Nation presets that do not stand yet (including newly created ones). Pick one, tap the map and [Place here]; it is founded there by its tier at the next server start.
dev_world_layout_found_pending: {nation} ({tier}) — home placed, founded at the next server start.
dev_world_layout_placed_blocked: Saved {nation}, but it cannot move now: {reasons}
dev_world_layout_cleared: Cleared {nation}. It goes back to automatic layout (existing cities stay).
dev_world_layout_code_not_land: No land nearby where a city can stand (no water, suitable height, temperature and rainfall).
dev_world_layout_code_reserved: Too close to the test map row; nations cannot be placed here.
dev_world_layout_code_failed: Could not place. Try again in a moment.
dev_world_layout_block_no_room: not enough room at the new home
dev_world_layout_block_other_cities: cities that are not start cities (towns)
dev_world_layout_city_lead: For each NPC nation start city, compare where buildings stand now with the strategic layout (government hall in the middle → lodgings → warehouses → gathering stations). Buildings a player is tied to (labor contracts, rent, postings, job assignments, building work) and player buildings never move.
dev_world_layout_city_failed: Could not load the city building layout.
dev_world_layout_city_none: No NPC cities to lay out again.
dev_world_layout_city_summary: {cities} cities · {moves} buildings to move · {pinned} kept because a player is tied to them
dev_world_layout_city_pending: Relayout booked ({when}) — applies at the next server start
dev_world_layout_city_request_hint: Once booked, the server moves only NPC buildings at its next start, keeping each building (facility, stored goods, jobs). If any building in a city cannot be placed, that city stays as it is. The action is audited.
dev_world_layout_catchment_show: Show catchments for the chosen nation
dev_world_layout_catchment_lead: A city lives on the six raw materials it gathers from the land around it. More people, a higher city grade and more tech widen the radius it needs. Where circles overlap, both cities gather the same land and both run out. Solid = current world (current radius), thin dots = target radius (size reached in the first period), dashed = sites after a world reset.
dev_world_layout_catchment_none: This nation has no capital yet, so there is nothing to draw.
dev_world_layout_catchment_summary: Same-nation gap {same} cells · foreign gap {foreign} cells (two province cities) · overlapping pairs: now {world} / plan {plan} · contested cells: now {contestedWorld} / plan {contestedPlan}
dev_world_layout_catchment_off: The catchment rule is off (radius 0, old grid layout). Circles still show each city's size.
dev_world_layout_catchment_own: This nation: {world} current cities · mean coverage {worldCover}‰ / {plan} planned · mean coverage {planCover}‰
dev_world_layout_catchment_ore_rule: Ore share by height: 0 m {low}‰ · {hillM} m {hill}‰ · {mountainM} m and up 1000‰. High tiers: mountains from {highM} m reach the ore vein range top, elsewhere only the outcrop range top (gather object ranges, D-562)
dev_an_lead_matrix: Pits primary-stat distributions with the same total against each other, many seeded battles per pair, using the server's combat judgement (the same Monte Carlo as the battle lab). Same seed, same result.
dev_an_lead_sensitivity: Moves points into one primary at a time (constant total) or adds points (+k), and the server measures how secondaries, combat specs and win rate against the base change.
dev_an_template_hint: Kind, K, weapon, gear, skills, elements and row come from the template; primaries come from the distribution. Uses this world's effective weight table, coefficients and growth rate.
dev_an_mode_sum: Primary sum at that level (no growth)
dev_an_mode_level: Starting sum, grown to the level (N5 · K)
dev_an_sums_hint: One table per selected total (up to {max})
dev_an_cost: {battles} battles · about {minutes} min if all run to the limit
dev_an_problem_budget: Worst-case cost exceeds the cap ({max} battle-seconds) — reduce battles, limit, distributions or totals
dev_an_problem_invalid: Settings out of range (at least 2 distributions, even battle count)
