dev_tool_gather_tiers_desc: Edit the T0–T9 weights (sum 1000‰) gathering facilities roll per effective-stat band, in one table.
dev_gather_ladder_note: Each ladder (raw material category) can have its own band table. Ladders without one use the default table (design D-540).
dev_gather_lead: Roll-mode gathering facilities (mine, lumber camp…) pick the output tier from the row matching the worker's effective stat. Edits are staged; [Apply] puts them into this world right away.
dev_gather_mode_note: Select + efficiency (farm, ranch) does not use this table: it picks the unlocked tier and stats only change speed and yield.
dev_gather_error_entry_changed: Someone changed the same band in the meantime.
dev_input_pack_tick: Tick = pack value {value} (click the tick to reset)
dev_input_scrub_hint: Drag the label sideways to change the value (Shift = ×10, Alt = fine).
dev_dist_help: Drag a boundary or change a part; the unlocked rest follows in proportion, so the sum stays fixed. ↑↓ = 1, Shift = 10.
dev_grid_none: Select cells (Shift+click = range, Ctrl+click = add, header = whole column).
dev_grid_fill_hint: Fills run between the first and last selected cell of each column.
dev_content_key_number: number fields: ↑↓ one step · Shift ×10 · drag the label or bar
dev_buildings_matrix_hint: Select several quantity cells to change or fill them together (header = whole column, drag a cell corner = fill down). The header curve is the real per-level quantity (qty × Lv² × multiplier). Add or remove materials and set the start level in the band panels below.
dev_gather_matrix_hint: Type a value and the rest of the band follows in proportion, so the sum stays 1000‰ (cells you just typed in the same band are kept). ↑↓ = same tier in the band above or below; drag a cell corner to fill down.
dev_buildings_look_desc: The low-poly 3D model built from code parts that stands on the 2nd map (same renderer and day light as the map). Footprint, model, wall and roof colour and height scale update the preview at once; after [Apply] map buildings change within 30 seconds. Level, condition, nation colour and night are preview-only (not saved).
dev_buildings_look_failed: The 3D preview cannot open on this device (WebGL). Fields can still be edited.
dev_buildings_look_keys: Drag or ←→↑↓ to rotate · wheel or +− to zoom · 0 to reset
dev_buildings_look_model_desc: Several facilities can share a model (the four storehouses differ only in size). Blank picks by facility ID.
dev_buildings_look_height_hint: Multiplies the height of every part above the pad. Blank = 1000‰
dev_buildings_look_icon_none: Map icon or image file: none — the 2nd map draws only this 3D model; the world map shows city badges.
dev_buildings_look_model_beacon: Territory beacon (stone tower, lit spire, emblem)
dev_buildings_look_model_fx_exchange: FX exchange (stone vault, gold dome, ticker)
dev_tool_production_desc: Edit the six primary production types (lumber camp, mine, herb field, farm, ranch, fishing spot): main and sub stats, yields, ladders, tier odds, plus the combat class table.
dev_prod_lead: Edit the stat pair, mode and yields of the six primary production types and see at once what a unit with stats X/Y produces. Edited cells are staged in the bar below; [Apply] puts them into this world right away.
dev_prod_expect_lead: Rows = initial sum of the two stats (main + secondary), columns = level. Each cell shows the effective stat range for K {kMin}–{kMax} and T0–T9 odds (each stat draws K uniformly in range). Growth {growth}, +{bonus} per facility level. Same formula as the game; staged edits from the odds tab show here at once.
dev_prod_expect_note: T9 appears rarely from effective stat 200–219 and rises from 220 (D-534). Condition is the ± from housing and food that suit the unit, separate from satisfaction. Half of it goes to each stat, so it also raises building gatherer (farm, ranch, herb garden) harvest efficiency. The facility bonus is 5 per level, so facility level 5 (+20) is smaller than the condition cap (+40) (D-535). The tier a building gatherer grows is set by its level (D-566).
dev_prod_secondary_hint: Sets how many come out at once.
dev_prod_mode_roll_hint: Rolls the tier from the odds table for the effective stat (main + sub) band.
dev_prod_mode_select_hint: Grows the top tier of the building level (2 × level − 1). If main + sub is below the recommended sum (20 × tier), harvest efficiency drops. Uses neither the odds table nor second-map objects (D-566·D-567).
dev_prod_warn_same_stat: Main and sub stat are the same. Using two different stats is recommended.
dev_prod_warn_coverage: This type shares a stat role with another type. Check the stat mapping tab: each stat should be the main of one type and the sub of one.
dev_prod_yield_formula: Per attempt = min(cap, base + ⌊{secondary} × ‰ ÷ 1000⌋) · speed = max(1, ⌊{primary} ÷ {divisor}⌋)
dev_prod_catch_hint: Success ‰ = min(cap, base + stat share × min(1, (main + sub) ÷ full sum)). A failed attempt only costs time.
dev_prod_site_note: Build materials, levels and map look are edited in the building editor; fatigue, required progress and the level bonus in the settings.
dev_prod_ladder_note: : turn items of this subcategory on or off or change their tier to change the ladder.
dev_prod_section_preview: Preview — when a unit with these stats works
dev_prod_result_efficiency: harvest efficiency {pct} (recommended sum = 20 × tier, no area modules)
dev_prod_chances_label: Chance of each tier per attempt
dev_prod_preview_note: Uses the same formulas as the game rules. It is an expected value: real output varies with the rolls, and station buffs, fatigue, storage caps and object uses are not included.
dev_prod_mapping_lead: Main (1) and sub (2) stat of the six primary production types. The mapping is even when each of the six stats is the main stat of one type and the sub stat of one type.
dev_prod_cover_ok: All six stats are used once as a main stat and once as a sub stat.
dev_prod_cover_warn: Stats are unevenly used (see the table below). Applying is not blocked.
dev_prod_cover_same: Types whose main and sub stat are the same: {names}
dev_prod_overview_lead: Sample columns show the expected count per hour for one unit whose main and sub stats both equal that value, in a level 1 facility (new unit average {stat}).
dev_prod_overview_note: Expected values. Counts are item counts; weight and price are not included.
dev_prod_recipes_note: Recipes are read-only (no recipe editing yet). Work slots per level: {slots}.
dev_prod_class_rule: Sort the six stats from high to low (ties in STR, VIT, INT, WIS, DEX, AGI order). If the lowest is at least {generalist}‰ of the highest: generalist. Otherwise, if the third is at least {three}‰: the top three stats; else the top two. Used for the recommendation only.
dev_prod_class_open_tuning: Thresholds are edited in the settings
dev_prod_class_form_note: The stat combination is not editable (the old 35-class table as is). Name, role and description show up in the unit recommendation as written.
dev_prod_issue_catch_range: The success cap is lower than the base.
dev_prod_issue_class_duplicate: A class with the same stat combination already exists.
dev_prod_issue_class_shape: A combination needs 2 or 3 different stats, or none.
dev_prod_issue_weights_sum: Band weights do not sum to 1000‰.
unit_advice_note: A suggestion based on stats. In primary production the main stat sets work speed, the sub stat sets yield and their sum sets the tier that comes out (other jobs are still allowed). The combat type is only a label and has no effect on combat rules.

build_claim_locked_independent: Your house is already an independent city-state. The new city will be independent too.

dev_report_reason_unknown_city: Can't find the real city (the world is off, the city is gone, or its map is not loaded).

dev_report_orders_empty: No orders — every party fights by its AI tactics.

boat_dock_time_sailing: Time bought. The boat is sailing to the trade dock.

boat_error_wrong_map: The boat and the facility are on different maps.

harbor_closed: Durability is below the limit: no new boats or jobs. Boats already in stay.
gather_stop_tier_too_high: The mounted catch gear can't catch this school's tier (needs fishers with catch gear)
harbor_load_empty: You have no goods to load at this port.
harbor_exchange_near: Harbor-side exchange: a porter carries unloaded goods into the exchange building storage (to the city warehouse if your locker is full).
boat_load_carrying: A porter is carrying the goods to the boat (in the hold in {time}).
boat_unload_carrying: A porter is carrying the hold's goods ashore (arrives in {time}).
boat_error_no_carrier: No unit to carry the goods. Keep one of your units on this map off the boat (or try again when one is free).
boat_error_not_catch_gear: This boat can't mount that gear.
boat_error_bad_slot: This boat has no such gun slot.
boat_error_hold_full: Not enough room in the hold.
harbor_impounded: Impounded — if the arrears pass the boat value {value} {currency}, the shipyard takes it
boat_unload_done: Unloaded the hold (into the harbor-side exchange building if there is one, otherwise your warehouse in that city). You can sell it on the exchange.
boat_error_no_fuel_items: No fuel items in the boat hold. Load fuel (whale oil etc.) onto the boat first.
inbox_boat_in_dock_title: {count} boats waiting in a shipyard dock

harbor_fee_repair: Service fee (one repair of another's boat — the shipyard pays materials and labor)

boat_error_not_docked: That boat is not in a dock.

boat_error_cooling: The engine is cooling (try again in {time}).
boat_error_own_boat: You cannot seize your own boat.

books_flows_none: No settlements, investments or deficits in this period.
books_goods_none: No goods in the business storage.

building_finance_not_business: This building is not a business, so it has no books.
building_operator_note: Operator mode: you are managing someone else's building. Commands act on the owner's behalf.

shares_err_unknown_order: That order was already matched or does not exist.

shares_rule_note: The largest holder runs the business (settlement, prices, wages, rent). Settlements split the vault by share.
dev_gather_objects_weights_hint: If you set any weight in a tier, that tier follows the weights and items without a weight never appear. A tier with no weights gives the representative item first, otherwise an even pick (D-562).
dev_gather_objects_waters_hint: Stands only when the second map's water kind (water bits, depth, biome; fresh if unknown) is one of those turned on. With none on, water kind is not checked (D-562).
cyborg_term_legend: Number after × = formula weight (counting ratio); number after = = that stat's share of this unit's value
cyborg_gather_level: Counted at facility Lv {level} (the workplace level if the unit works there, otherwise Lv 1)
cyborg_gather_price_market: Prices = last trade price at this unit's city exchange (start price for goods with no trade)
cyborg_gather_price_start: Prices = start prices (no trades at this city exchange)
reserve_hint: At settlement the vault keeps money so wages never stop. It works out wages until the next settlement plus one month of missing deposit, and keeps {margin} more for wage rises. Even at 0% it always keeps the wages due before the next settlement. The kept money tops up missing deposits first.
reserve_none: No wage contracts right now, so nothing is kept.
facility_outsource_fee: Service fee {fee} (the shop pays materials and labor)
fid_home_error_unknown_city: That city could not be found. Refresh the list and pick again.
fid_home_error_same_city: That city is already the home city.
fid_home_error_wait: The home city was changed recently. You can change it again later.
fid_house_notice_home_changed: Leader {other} changed the home city of {house}.
fid_home_unaffiliated: You have no house, so you are unaffiliated. Home city: {where}.
fid_home_unaffiliated_hint: Unaffiliated players pay personal tax to their home city at the rate its government sets. To hire new units, found a house or join one (founding is free). Joining a house moves you to its nation.
fid_home_hint: A house belongs to the nation of its home city, and every member is a citizen of that nation. Taxes and rankings count toward this city.
fid_home_locked: A house that holds a city has that city as its home city.
fid_home_change_note: Changing it moves every member's nation and home city to the new home city and its nation.
fid_home_pending: Announced: the whole house moves to {where} on {when}.
fid_home_pending_fee: Policy there: the house pays an entry fee of {amount} all at once on the move (from the house vault first, then the leader's wallet). If it can't, the house doesn't move.
fid_home_pending_grant: Policy there: the house receives a grant of {amount} all at once on the move (into the house vault).
fid_home_pending_free: Policy there: no entry fee or grant.
fid_home_pending_leave: If you disagree, you can leave the house before then (your nation and home city stay as they are).
fid_home_notice_rule: Notice period: {days} d. Then the whole house moves together; members who disagree can leave meanwhile.
fid_home_done_announced: New home city announced. The whole house moves when the notice period ends.
fid_house_notice_home_announced: Leader {other} announced that {house} will move its home city to {city}. If you disagree, you can leave the house before then.
fid_house_notice_home_cancelled: Leader {other} withdrew the home city move of {house}.
fid_house_notice_home_cancelled_city: {house} gained a city, so the home city move was withdrawn.
fid_house_notice_home_cancelled_gone: The destination city is gone, so the home city move of {house} was withdrawn.
fid_home_wait: You can change it again from {when}.
fid_home_wait_rule: After a change you must wait {days} days to change again.
fid_home_found_hint: The house and you join the nation this city belongs to (one nation). Taxes and rankings count toward this city. The leader can change it later.
recruit_err_no_house: You need a house to hire units.
recruit_need_house: You need a house to hire units. Found one (free) or join one.
facility_error_sale_only: Business storage is for sale only. Owners also buy at the sale price in the building panel [Books] (the money counts as business sales).
books_err_no_carrier: No carrier for the goods you bought. Put a worker at that building or one of your units on this map and they walk it to city storage.
books_sale_note: Owners buy at the sale price too. The money counts as this business's sales.
station_buy_haul: Buy at sale price to city storage
station_buy_haul_done: Bought. The money counts as business sales, and a carrier walks the goods to city storage.
facility_place_sale_only: Business goods · buy them at the sale price in the building panel [Books]
facility_move_no_carrier: No carrier for the goods. Put a worker at that building or one of your humans or cyborg units on this map and they walk it to city storage.
market_err_no_exchange: This city has no goods exchange building, so you can't place orders here.
fx_err_no_exchange: No nation using this currency has a currency exchange building, so it can't be exchanged.
facility_error_exchange_exists: This city already has this kind of exchange. Each city has one.
fx_exchange_none: No nation using this currency has a currency exchange building, so orders are closed for now.
market_exchange_none: This city has no goods exchange building, so you can't place orders. You can still cancel open orders.
market_exchange_at: Exchange: {name}. Goods you sell must be in this building's storage.
battle_cmd_pick_cell: Tap the battlefield to choose a cell.
battle_cmd_locked: Just ordered. You can order again in about a second.
dev_lab_rank_hint: The commander cap (parties) is the title table plus the rebirth bonus, 3 to 10 (D-571 — title only). The tier (combat ranking) only orders who takes temporary command after the title when the commander falls or retreats.
books_col_withholding: Income tax withheld from wages (already in costs)
books_stop_scheduled: The vault has no money for wages, so only one last cycle runs on a deficit. The business stops at {at} and restarts once the deficit is repaid and the next wages are in the vault.
fair_price_hint: The seller sets the price. The fair price roughly adds materials, labor, fees and tax.
repair_service_hint: This workshop's workers repair gear others bring in, using materials from this workshop's storage (customers pay only the fee). Charge = hourly rate × repair time. If unset, the fair price is charged; 0 means no outsourced work.
repair_service_no_workers: No workers to repair, so no outsourced work. Assign or hire workers.
facility_outsource_workers: {count} of that workshop's workers repair it
facility_error_no_shop_worker: That business has no worker free (workshop repair or logistics haul).
facility_error_service_closed: That business is not taking this now (workshop repairs or logistics hauls — fee 0 or not available here).
market_exchange_stopped: This city's goods exchange building is below 30% condition and has stopped. Orders can't be placed until it is repaired. Open orders can still be withdrawn.
market_err_locker_full: Not enough room in your exchange locker. Expand it or take goods out.
market_err_locker_max: Your locker can't be expanded any further.
market_desk_rule: Each trade-desk unit adds 1 to your order limit per 20 INT + WIS, and carries your locker deliveries and pick-ups at this exchange first and faster. It produces nothing.
market_desk_no_free: None of your units are idle in this exchange's area.
tactics_hint: When this unit meets units of another nation, these tactics decide whether it fights or avoids. It never starts a fight while its owner is offline or it is working.
tactics_saved: Saved. The next encounter uses these tactics.
tactics_result_unknown: Unit not found. Reload the list.
tactics_result_offline: Connection lost. Save again once reconnected.
tactics_result_retry: Could not save right now. Try again shortly.
fid_house_error_not_ruler: Only the head of the house that holds this city (city policy) or is this nation (nation policy) can set it.
fid_home_error_entry_fee: The house vault and the leader's wallet together can't cover the entry fee, so the house can't move.
fid_house_notice_home_cancelled_fee: The entry fee couldn't be paid, so the home city move of {house} was withdrawn.
government_entry_hint: The fee a house pays, or the grant it receives, all at once when it moves its home city here (amount per member × members). The city amount and, when coming from another nation, the nation amount are both charged separately.
government_entry_invalid: Whole numbers only (up to 15 digits, put − first for a grant).
build_problem_house_policy: Another house of your nation has closed its city to other houses, so you can't build here.
fid_house_error_insufficient_funds: Your wallet holds less than that amount.
fid_house_error_tax_too_high: That house tax rate is above the cap.
fid_house_done_build_policy: Building rule for other houses set.
fid_house_tax_line: House tax {rate}% (taken from members' wages and business payouts into the vault)
fid_house_donate_hint: Moves money from your wallet into the house vault. The vault pays house move fees first.
fid_house_donate_invalid: Enter a whole amount of 1 or more (up to 15 digits).
fid_house_tax_hint: 0–{max}%, in 0.1% steps. This share of members' wages and business payouts goes to the house vault.
fid_house_tax_invalid: Enter a house tax rate from 0 to {max}%, with at most one decimal place.
fid_house_take_hint: Moves house vault money into your wallet. Every member sees it in the vault ledger.
fid_house_vault_log_empty: No money has moved in or out of the vault yet.
government_build_hint: Whether other houses of the same nation may build in this city. The house that owns the city can always build.
government_leader_rule_dictator: Dictatorship: the ruling house head decides everything
government_leader_rule_vote: Democracy: member houses are to decide by vote — until voting opens, the ruling house head represents the nation for now
government_leader_rule_shares: Capitalism: to be decided by a vote weighted by shares — until voting opens, the ruling house head represents the nation for now
market_err_unknown_unit: That unit's locker can't be expanded (not your unit).
market_locker_units: {count} of your units × {base} kg base + expansions
market_locker_no_units: You have no units, so you have no locker (each unit gets a small locker).
market_desk_closed: The owner of this exchange offers no trade-desk seats.
market_desk_owner_hint: To offer seats to others, set an hourly rent under Workers & contracts on the building panel.
fx_fee_line: FX usage fee {pct}% — paid from the base currency you receive when you sell this currency (cheapest exchange in this nation).
fx_fee_service_hint: Each FX round for this nation's currency, sellers pay what they receive × the rate. The exchange with the lowest rate collects it. If unset, the fair rate applies; 0 means no fee.
boat_price_closed: Price 0 — this boat is not built.
inbox_labor_paused_title: {count} of my units stopped working — the employer's deposit ran out (wait or end the contract)
dev_nations_section_temper_desc: Faction temperament on four axes (0–1000) and the leader's disposition. Empty fields are random from the world seed. Gathering tiers, city growth and NPC decisions read them; changes apply from the next server start.
dev_nations_temper_leader_desc: Position within the leader-disposition range setting (+ = bold, − = cautious). 1000 = the end of the range.
fid_house_vault_hint: House money kept apart from the treasury. It pays entry fees first and takes grants when the house moves. In a dictatorship house nation, the treasury's share of city profit comes here.
harbor_repair_fair: If you set no repair fee, each repair charges its fair price. For reference: fully repairing the first boat type costs {price} {currency}
harbor_repair_fee_fair: Repair fee at this shipyard: each repair's fair price in {currency} (the shipyard pays materials and labor)
inbox_action_waited: Warning folded on all your devices. The contract stays paused and resumes once the business earns again.
inbox_action_failed: Could not do that. Try again from the economy screen.
exchange_fee_service_hint: On every fill at this goods exchange the seller pays total × rate into this building's vault. Unset means the fair rate; you can only set a rate within the allowed range.
boat_unload_waiting: No unit free to carry the goods, so the order is waiting. A porter will carry them once one of your units off the boat is on this map.
boat_load_waiting: No unit free to carry the goods, so the order is waiting. They will be carried to the boat once one of your units off the boat is on this map.
settings_auto_haul_hint: When none of your units can carry, hand the haul to the cheapest logistics center in the same city (the fee is paid in that nation's currency when it leaves). Saved to your account, so every device uses it.
settings_auto_haul_unavailable: The server is not ready yet, so this can't be changed.
settings_auto_haul_failed: Couldn't change it. Please try again shortly.
facility_haul_own_auto: My units, else a logistics center
facility_haul_center_mine: My logistics center #{id} · {price} per unit · {workers} free
haul_service_hint: Hauls handed over by others (exchange deposits and withdrawals, shop sales, boat loading and unloading, NPC hauls) are carried on foot by this center's workers. You earn the unit fee × weight and distance units (in this city's nation currency), paid when the haul leaves. If unset, the fair price is charged; 0 means not taking hauls.
haul_service_no_workers: No carriers, so no hauls are taken. Assign or hire workers.
dev_terrain_lab_model_empty: Select an object in the table to inspect its 3D model.
dev_terrain_lab_model_keys: Drag orbit · Wheel zoom · Box = 1 cell (5.86m)
home_units_empty_hint: No units deployed yet. Recruit and organize squads in Units.
home_maps_local_desc: Jump directly to your cyborg's active 2nd map
home_maps_world_desc: Inspect planetary factions, frontlines, resources & armies
dev_tool_exp_table_desc: Tune the shared Lv 1–60 EXP table for cyborgs, humans, and creatures with a curve generator and lifespan pacing charts.
dev_exp_lead: Shared EXP table for cyborgs, humans, and creatures. Compare Lv 50 and Lv 60 pacing against unit lifespan (2–3 months), tune via curve builder or table, and live-apply.
dev_exp_builder_desc: Set targets and steepness for Lv 1–50 and Lv 50–60 to generate exact integer spans for all 59 levels.
dev_exp_sim_desc: Adjust hourly XP and active hours per day to see what level a unit reaches within its 60–90 day lifespan.
dev_exp_chart_lifespan_title: Days to Level vs Unit Lifespan
dev_exp_chart_lifespan_desc: Green band shows the 1–2 month target (30–60d); amber band shows unit lifespan (T4: {min}–{max}d). Click any level to focus.
dev_exp_chart_cum_desc: Compare the growth slope from Lv 1–{cap} vs Lv {cap}–{max}.
dev_exp_chart_span_desc: Required EXP for each span (Lv L → L+1). Non-monotonic drops are highlighted in red.
gov_suspended: Since the switch to dictatorship, other shares carry no votes.
gov_propose_decree_note: In a dictatorship the leader changes the regime by authority; it takes effect after a grace period.
gov_done_decided: Decided by authority. It takes effect after the grace period.
gov_no_nation: You do not belong to a nation.
gov_err_no_nation: You do not belong to a nation.
gov_err_already_open: The same agenda is already open.
gov_err_limit: You have too many open agendas.
gov_err_same_regime: The nation already has that regime.
gov_err_no_majority: The ruling side lacks a share majority.
government_tax_hint: Taxes set by the nation. Income tax applies at one rate to business income and wages (withheld by the business); resident tax is charged each period on the value of the housing a resident unit lives in and of its owner's business buildings in that city. Resident tax minus the national share is city tax. There is no tax cap.
government_tax_done_reopen: National taxes set. Fields reset to default show their values when you reopen.
government_tax_invalid: Rates must be numbers in range (income tax 0–100%, up to two decimals · resident tax and national share 0–1000‰ · period 1–365 days).
gov_tax_target: New rates: income tax {income} · resident tax {resident}
government_tax_agenda_opened: The change is large, so a tax agenda was opened. It applies if the vote passes.
dev_tuning_problem_ai_range_order: NPC AI ranges: every minimum value must be ≤ its maximum value
dev_tuning_problem_ai_blend_sum: NPC org trait blend: each regime/organization share group must sum to 1000‰ (100%)
dev_tool_npc_ai_desc: 7-axis trait generation ranges, regime org blending, loyalty override curves, unit/strategy/combat tuning, and decision lab
dev_npc_ai_lead: Tune 7-axis unit trait ranges, regime-based leader/member/base blending, loyalty override curves, and NPC strategy/combat values with live server preview.
dev_npc_ai_gen_desc: Adjust role min-max ranges and home-anchor spread (±) to preview the 200-unit distribution.
dev_npc_ai_blend_desc: Decision axes (belligerence, boldness, autonomy) weight leaders more; culture axes weight members and national base.
dev_npc_ai_loyalty_desc: As human loyalty drops, individual 7-axis traits override player tactics. Androids stay 0%; creatures use wild instinct.
dev_npc_ai_curve_aria: Trait override curve by loyalty level
dev_npc_ai_switches_desc: Immediately pause or resume faction, unit, or house AI during live operations.
dev_npc_ai_unit_title: Unit Routine, Patrol, House Intervals & Decision Temperature
dev_npc_ai_unit_desc: Adjust min-max ranges for unit re-evaluation, dwell time (anti-oscillation), guard patrol radius, and house decision cycles.
dev_npc_ai_combat_preview_desc: Adjust unit kind, loyalty, and 7-axis traits to preview how player tactics blend with unit instinct.
dev_npc_ai_encounter_desc: Tune squad commander trait share, encounter scan timing, power ratios, and retreat thresholds.
dev_npc_ai_lab_desc: Runs the real server scoring engine (explainActions7) with staged edits to inspect candidate scores and factor breakdowns.
dev_npc_ai_lab_error: Failed to load server decision preview.
dev_npc_ai_schedule_desc: Adjust unit role and 7-axis traits to preview the server 8-state FSM hourly schedule (work, gather, shop, patrol, rest, travel).
gov_err_coup_disabled: Coups are not possible right now.
gov_err_coup_cooldown: You must wait longer before another coup.
gov_err_coup_open: A coup is already under way in this nation.
gov_err_unknown_coup: That coup does not exist or is no longer taking sides.
gov_err_not_enough_shares: The treasury does not hold enough shares.
gov_done_coup_started: Coup launched. The battle starts when sign-up ends.
